h1: Custom Pink Pedometers for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom pink pedometers in bulk for your wellness program. Engage employees with branded step counters from Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Pink pedometers add a vibrant touch to corporate wellness initiatives, making step tracking feel less clinical and more personal. Whether you're outfitting a breast cancer awareness walk or simply want a pop of color in your employee fitness challenge, these devices pair well with screen printing or a subtle debossed logo. The bright casing stands out on lanyards or clips, encouraging daily use and reinforcing your health-focused message.
heroAltText: Custom pink pedometer with digital display and clip, perfect for employee wellness programs and branded giveaways.
